items.computation: Anchor: Rechnungsdatum 20.11.2026 (a private invoice, not an authority letter, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the stated start is the invoice date itself). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 21.11.2026. A 14-day period ending under § 188 Abs. 1 BGB lands on 04.12.2026 (Friday). That day is a business day in NW (no holiday), so under § 193 BGB no shift is needed. Due date: 04.12.2026.
